name: Cohere
summary: Cohere is an AI company in Toronto, founded in 2019 by Aidan Gomez and others. It builds [language models for enterprise use](https://techcrunch.com/2025/08/14/cohere-hits-a-6-8b-valuation-as-investors-amd-nvidia-and-salesforce-double-down/). Its research lab, Cohere Labs, releases open-weight models.
